reviews.author: Daniel Harrington
reviews.text: Showed up fast! Joe was super professional and helpful. This is the best towing experience I have ever had. I will always use Trusted Towing in the future!

reviews.author: Ryan Foster
reviews.text: I was so thankful that my mechanic referred me to Joe at Trusted Towing. He was easy to work with, very kind, showed up when he said he would, and did an overall great job. He seemed very competent in his work, and was very reasonably priced. I would highly recommend him to anyone in need of a tow.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.text: I highly recommend Trusted Towing Inc. to anyone needing a vehicle tow. I needed to tow my classic car to my mechanic, which required special care, and Joe took extra steps to ensure that the car was delivered safely. Joe provided excellent customer service and followed up with me after delivering the car to let me know it arrived at the shop. I appreciated the extra courtesy. It is clear he cares about his customers.

reviews.author: Hannah Smith
reviews.text: After my husband was in a collision, trusted towing came and moved his car for us. The gentleman helping us was knowledgeable, kind, and the perfect person to tow after being in an accident. Would recommend!!

reviews.author: Jeremy David
reviews.text: Being from out of town and not knowing any tow companies, this was one of the best tow companies I had dealt with throughout the US driver was completely friendly, even followed up couple days after to make sure everything was good with my truck. I highly recommend them and will be using them again if I ever need another tow while I’m working in Greensboro.

reviews.author: Kimberley Boyer
reviews.text: Joe was awesome and helped get my son home for thanksgiving! He broke down two hours from home and Joe replaced a belt and had him back on the road in an hour on a holiday! Fantastic service, very kind and friendly, and great work! Above and beyond assistance! Very grateful we found him!

reviews.author: Hannah Hieber
reviews.text: Joe is super nice! He was super fast and helped us save money too, which is always awesome. It’s really cool to see an honest hardworking guy who’s in it to take care of the customers! Will use again!

reviews.author: Joshua Silver
reviews.text: I had my car towed today by Joseph's Trusted Towing. He showed up on time and dropped off the vehicle with attention and care. Excellent communication skills and very responsive. 100% recommend and give this towing service 5-stars!

reviews.author: Damon Duncan
reviews.text: Highly recommended, me and my family were stranded on blewes lake and the owner was the only person to stop and help us get to the dock( on his own time). He also gave me some very appreciated knowledge. There not a marine recovery company. They helped me out of the kindness of their heart

reviews.author: Chanel Wise
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!! They were very friendly over the phone and extremely helpful. I felt like family. Joe came out and was amazing!! He even recommended a auto shop for me to go to for other services.

reviews.author: Machine Jones
reviews.text: Where to begin. My girlfriend and I were on our way to Asheville, when our car just gave out on us. We suspected it happens to be the alternator but, not sure yet. The insurance company had been jerking us around for 3 hours straight pretending to send a tow truck, until Joe answered the call. Joe saved us like Batman would a dame under the claws of The Joker. He was an awesome dude, cared, got us out of our unfortunate situation, and got us safely to our Volvo dealership. Joe was beyond exceptional. This is by far the best tow truck company I have ever had to deal with. Trusted tow owns their name right because they are trusted. Trusted by a new customer. Thank you Joe and thank you Trusted Towing Co.

reviews.author: Wes Gilbert
reviews.text: Needed my car towed to a shop about 30 minutes from my house, I knew I needed to call Trusted. He showed up in no time and the process was easier than it ever has been! The car made it to its destination perfectly and on time. Won't hesitate to call Joseph or recommend him to anyone in need!

reviews.author: dbdman11
reviews.text: Best in the business. First place I call to tow me and my families vehicles whenever I have a breakdown or need something transported. You can count on them to get your vehicle or equipment loaded up and delivered safely at a fair rate!

reviews.author: Belinda Braxton
reviews.text: My daughter and I were stuck outside her job (10pm) because my battery died. Called AAA they couldn't assist until 2am. We started calling area towing companies and Trusted Towing was the first on my list to call. Dale was there in 20 minutes. He was the sweetest and professional!!!!! He made sure we good and followed us out. 5-stars and then some for Dale!!!!!

reviews.author: Miguel Cruz
reviews.text: Joe was the gentleman that helped me. He was very professional and knowledgeable. I definitely recommend trusted towing to anyone.

reviews.author: Michae Vance
reviews.text: Great company showed up right away got my car running in just a few minutes would highly recommend Trusted Towing for towing and breakdowns needs.

reviews.author: Lauren Ingold
reviews.text: Super friendly and fast. Great to work with and very reasonable rates. We have used them twice and each time was easy. We appreciate them helping us! Definitely lives up to the name.

reviews.author: Selo Kuvuna
reviews.text: Very professional group, Joe was exceptional from the pickup to the destination drop. Extremely fast and convenient from the timing of my request.

reviews.author: Mike Hughes
reviews.text: I didn't have to wait long at all, and he helped me fix the problem so that I didn't need the tow. Very much appreciated. Great service!

reviews.author: Antonio Rodriguez
reviews.text: Joe saved the day, I drive a banged out 92 eclipse that’s slammed to the ground and he had no issue with it. Best guy for the job !

reviews.author: Chris B.MASTER
reviews.text: Joe is very trustworthy and reliable, and is dedicated to his work and comes highly recommended by all that use his service . Call him first , you won't be disappointed

reviews.author: Felix Hernandez
reviews.text: Great customer service. Joe was a great help in my time of need today. 10 out of 10 great price as well

reviews.author: Nevan Cantrell
reviews.text: I’ve used Joseph the last 3-4 years and have have nothing but great things to say. Always on time and truthful. Quality service and honesty

reviews.author: Elijah Alllmond
reviews.text: He worked around my schedule and was on time. Super polite and professional. I will be calling him again
